contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy Nummus, probably of Valentinian I, AD364-375. Mint is Lyon, AD364-375, (Reece period 19). Reverse legend reads GLORIA ROMANORVM. Reverse shows Emperor advancing right, dragging captive and holding standard. Obverse shows diademed bust right. Obverse legend reads [...](VALENTINI?)-[...]. Reverse fields and exergue read: O F[...]//LVG[...]. Die axis is 6 o'clock, weight is 1.99g,…
